title: Moving push notification consent data to the server
goal: Move the push notification consent values the app kept only in device storage to the server, so consent survives a device change or a reinstall. After the migration, verify the app and server consent values agree.
doneWhen: Consent data is migrated to the server and the app-server value comparison and send-blocking checks pass.

items.label: Consent fields
items.title: App consent fields defined
items.body: Defined consent per notification type and the consent timestamp as fields, and fixed the format sent to the server together with the device identifier. Fields the server does not know are ignored and not stored.

items.label: Collection deploy
items.title: App collection code deployed
items.body: Added code that sends the consent value to the server whenever it changes, and keeps it in a queue for resend when sending fails. The rollout was staged.

items.label: Receive schema
items.title: Consent receive schema prepared
items.body: Created the server table holding the consent value and change time, keyed so that only the latest value from the same device is kept.

items.label: Migration batch
items.title: Migration batch written
items.body: Wrote the batch that takes the consent values the app kept and writes them into the server table. When an incoming value is older than the stored one, it is skipped instead of stored.

items.label: Consent migration
items.title: Consent history migration run
items.body: Moved every account's consent values to the server overnight and carried unprocessed rows into the next run. There were 4.12 million rows to migrate.

items.label: App switch verify
items.title: App switch verified
items.body: Changed the app to read server values instead of local ones and confirmed consent stays intact through a device change and a reinstall.

items.label: Migration verify
items.title: Migration verified and send blocking confirmed
items.body: Compared app and server consent values across a 50,000-row sample with no mismatches. Confirmed from send logs that no push goes out for accounts with consent turned off.

changes.title: Migration order changed to server first
changes.body: Running the app rollout and the server migration on the same day left no clear source of truth for the consent value, so the order was changed to finish the server migration first and have the app read server values.
